payload.body: Reparented out of FR-15: the calls epic delivered its full scope (P2P, mediasoup SFU + multi-box placement, control plane, presence, UI) and the E2EE obligation (FR-85, deferred-design) shipped as design doc + key-epoch seam. FR-156 is net-new future hardening — the production SFrame cipher suite + Encoded-Transform wiring — tracked independently.
